name: Feature Request
about: Propose a use case, an additive spec change, or a new profile
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that packstruct does not make easy today?

## Proposed change

Be specific. If this touches the spec, say whether it is additive (a new optional field, a host-owned key, a new profile) - additive rows keep the schema number; removals or renames need a migration note (SPEC section 11).

## Which hosts would adopt it

A change with a real consumer is far more likely to land. Name the repos or engines that would use it.

## Alternatives considered

Anything you tried or ruled out.
